concept_prompt: Create SIX SEPARATE landscape instructional illustrations as six individual output files, for a bilingual Filipino BHW lesson. Use the attached pinned Carole reference faithfully: same recognizable Filipina face, long dark wavy hair, teal polo, navy trousers, practical closed shoes. Warm painterly realistic illustration, cream background, simple uncluttered Philippine barangay health setting, no text or logos or personal records. Distinct scenes in this exact order: 1 compare-solutions: Carole and a resident compare a poster proposal against a clock/calendar proposal for scheduling and childcare barriers; 2 plan: Carole fills a blank seven-row plan with empty cells and a separate pending agreement marker, no letters/numbers; 3 partners: Carole listening with midwife in plain white blouse and two adult residents including a parent, role/commitment map with blank cards, no promise; 4 review: Carole and midwife review a before/after board showing three anonymous household icons on each side, one attended filled icon and two missed hollow icons per side, residents thoughtfully clarify work/childcare concerns; 5 practice: classroom triad Carole recommends plan to partner while observer holds blank checklist, rehearsal/retry; 6 check: Carole returns an honest revised provisional plan to health team and residents, listening rather than celebrating, pending agreement, no implied solved problem. Maintain continuity across all six. Each file must depict only its own scene; do not make a contact sheet. Save the six outputs in the workspace if possible, return filesystem paths.
